words.ex: Keep your resume to one page.

words.m: a meeting to select you for a job

words.ex: The salary is credited on the 1st.
My goal is an IT job.

tips.t: One page. Projects first, hobbies last.
tips.b: Name, phone, email, LinkedIn on top. Your best project in 2 lines: what you built + tool used. No photo, no father's name, no full address.
tips.kn: ಒಂದೇ ಪುಟ. ಮೊದಲು ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್, ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಹವ್ಯಾಸ.

tips.b: Start each line with a verb: Built, Led, Organised, Improved. Add a number where you can: 'Organised a fest for 400 students'.
Name → course → 1 project → 1 strength → why this company. Practise it aloud on the 🎤 English page.
tips.kn: ಹೆಸರು → ಕೋರ್ಸ್ → ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ → ಶಕ್ತಿ → ಏಕೆ ಈ ಕಂಪನಿ.

tips.b: Know what the company does, one product, and where its office is. Saying it shows you are serious.
Most company tests have no negative marks. Skip a hard one after 60 seconds, come back at the end, and guess if time runs out.
tips.kn: ಖಾಲಿ ಬಿಡಬೇಡಿ; 60 ಸೆಕೆಂಡ್ ನಂತರ ಮುಂದೆ ಹೋಗಿ.

tips.t: Check your setup the day before
tips.b: Charged phone / laptop, stable internet, ID card ready, quiet room. Log in 15 minutes early.
Be among the first 3 to speak. Add one point with an example, then let others talk. Sum up at the end if nobody does.
'I agree with Ravi, and I would add that…' sounds team-friendly and still shows your idea.
Light shirt, dark trousers, formal shoes. Girls: formal kurta or shirt. No bright colours or big logos.
tips.kn: ಸರಳ ಫಾರ್ಮಲ್ ಉಡುಪು, ಇಸ್ತ್ರಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ಬಟ್ಟೆ.

tips.b: Clear photo, headline like 'BCA 2027 · Java · SQL', and your 🏅 Davan Placement certificates under Licences & certifications.
Plus your ID, a pen, and certificates in a file. Reach 30 minutes early.

tips.t: Ask one question at the end
tips.b: 'What does a fresher learn in the first 6 months here?' shows interest. Never ask only about salary first.
